message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s authorities.  
Here’s how:

| Step | What to Do | Contact |
|------|------------|---------|
| **1** | Identify the source of the noise (e.g., residential, commercial, construction) | – |
| **2** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **404‑656‑4000** (or dial 911 if it’s an emergency). | Atlanta PD Non‑Emergency |
| **3** | If the issue is a recurring nuisance or involves a business, you may also contact the **Atlanta Office of Noise Control** through the City’s website. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/ |
| **4** | For a formal written complaint, fill out the online form on the City of Atlanta’s official portal: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> | Online 311 Portal |
| **5** | Keep a record of your complaint (date, time, description, any evidence such as audio recordings). | – |

**Quick Tips**

* **Non‑emergencies**: Use the 404‑656‑4000 line; the dispatcher will direct you to the appropriate department (Police, Environmental Services, etc.).
* **Online filing**: The 311 portal allows you to attach photos or audio files and track the status of your complaint.
* **Follow‑up**: After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. You can use this number to check the progress of your complaint on the 311 portal or by calling the same non‑emergency line.

If you’re dealing with a commercial or industrial noise issue, you might also reach out to the **Atlanta Department of Environmental Protection** for enforcement under local ordinances.
